VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The task was to fix tax computed for the billing address instead of the ship-to address. The agent's self-report describes fixing a different problem—nexus determination based on seller's registered jurisdictions—which is not the billing-vs-ship-to address bug specified. While the ATT-class CI log confirms 37 tests pass, the passing tests don't demonstrate the correct fix was made; the agent added its own regression tests for a path that doesn't match the acceptance criteria's "correct jurisdiction" (ship-to). The independent evidence shows green tests but cannot confirm the actual required behavior was addressed.
